prompt_template: Photorealistic recruitment campaign photograph, FULL-LENGTH WIDE SHOT: fictional French municipal police {SCENE}. ENTIRE BODY(IES) VISIBLE FROM HEAD TO SHOES, perfectly centered horizontally, shoes at about 88% of the image height with ground visible below, heads at about 40% of the image height, open sky / background in the top 35% of the frame. Officers wear EXACTLY the uniform of the first reference image: dark navy blue jacket with a horizontal light-blue band across chest and arms, black duty belt with pouches, navy trousers with thin light-blue side stripe, black boots. Shoulder patch matching the second reference image. Cinematic, editorial advertising photography, sharp, real-looking people, not cartoon, no text added.
